notes: The Libya-Egypt frontier as printed on map C (a blue line along hexsides, so no hex is split). On map C a hex CRRCC is in Egypt when its column CC is at least first_egypt_col[RR], else in Libya; 34 means the row has no Egyptian land (rows 42-51 east of the line are sea).

Maps A and B are wholly Libya and maps D and E wholly Egypt: no frontier is printed on B or D (checked at reduced scale), and A and E lie beyond them. Malta and the off-map boxes are not countries for this purpose.

Read twice from the scan (jp2 189), once by the measured hex grid and once by the printed hex numbers: the 41 rows with land on both sides agree exactly. Anchors: Sollum C4021, Halfaya C3922, Sidi Omar C3618 and Siwa C0127 in Egypt; Fort Capuzzo C4020, Bardia C4321, Fort Maddalena C3019 and Giarabub C1014 in Libya.
